name: acad-geometry-2d
description: AutoCAD 2D geometry primitives: create lines, polylines, circles, arcs, ellipses, rectangles, polygons, splines, points, donuts, xlines, rays, single- and multi-line text, hatches and revision clouds; query entities (entity descriptor, bounding box, length, area, intersections, distances) inside a rectangular window; modify with offset, trim, extend, join, explode, fillet, chamfer and delete. All write operations require the AcadMcp .NET plugin loaded inside an open AutoCAD session (NETLOAD or auto-bundle). Read-only tools are flagged ReadOnly = true.
intent_examples: arc by center radius and angle
closest distance from point to curve

tools_summary.name: chamfer_corner
tools_summary.description: Chamfer two curves at their intersection with two distances; returns the new chamfer line.

tools_summary.name: delete_entities
tools_summary.description: Erase entities by handle. Pass multiple in one batch for atomicity.

tools_summary.name: draw_arc
tools_summary.description: Draw an arc by center, radius, and start/end angle in degrees (CCW).

tools_summary.name: draw_circle
tools_summary.description: Draw a circle by center point and radius.

tools_summary.name: draw_donut
tools_summary.description: Draw a donut (filled annulus) at a center, with inner and outer diameters.

tools_summary.name: draw_ellipse
tools_summary.description: Draw an ellipse by center, major-axis end point and minor-to-major ratio (0 < ratio <= 1).

tools_summary.name: draw_hatch
tools_summary.description: Apply an associative hatch over closed boundaries identified by handle.

tools_summary.name: draw_line
tools_summary.description: Draw a 2D straight line segment between two points on the active drawing.

tools_summary.name: draw_mtext
tools_summary.description: Draw multiline text (MTEXT) with wrap-width and height.

tools_summary.name: draw_point
tools_summary.description: Draw a single point entity at a 2D position.

tools_summary.name: draw_polygon
tools_summary.description: Draw a regular polygon (3..1024 sides), inscribed or circumscribed.

tools_summary.name: draw_polyline
tools_summary.description: Draw a 2D lightweight polyline through the given vertex list, optionally closed.

tools_summary.name: draw_ray
tools_summary.description: Draw a half-infinite ray from a base point in a given direction.

tools_summary.name: draw_rectangle
tools_summary.description: Draw an axis-aligned rectangle as a closed polyline by two opposite corners.

tools_summary.name: draw_revcloud
tools_summary.description: Draw a revision cloud polyline through the given vertices with arc-length min/max.

tools_summary.name: draw_spline
tools_summary.description: Draw a 2D spline interpolated through the given fit points, optionally closed.

tools_summary.name: draw_text
tools_summary.description: Draw single-line text (DTEXT) at a 2D position with given height/rotation/style.

tools_summary.name: draw_xline
tools_summary.description: Draw an infinite construction line through a base point in a given direction.

tools_summary.name: explode_entity
tools_summary.description: Explode a polyline/block/hatch into its component primitives.

tools_summary.name: extend_curve
tools_summary.description: Extend a curve until it reaches one of the boundary entities.

tools_summary.name: fillet_corner
tools_summary.description: Fillet two curves at their intersection with the given radius; returns the new fillet arc.

tools_summary.name: get_area
tools_summary.description: Return enclosed area for a closed curve (circle, ellipse, closed polyline, hatch).

tools_summary.name: get_bounding_box
tools_summary.description: Return axis-aligned bounding box of an entity by handle (XY plane).

tools_summary.name: get_curve_length
tools_summary.description: Return curve length (perimeter) of a line/polyline/arc/spline by handle.

tools_summary.name: get_distance_points
tools_summary.description: Return Cartesian distance between two 2D points.

tools_summary.name: get_distance_to_entity
tools_summary.description: Return shortest distance from a 2D point to a curve entity by handle.

tools_summary.name: get_entity
tools_summary.description: Return full descriptor (class, layer, color, bbox, length, area, endpoints) of an entity by handle.

tools_summary.name: get_intersections
tools_summary.description: Return XY intersection points between two curves identified by handle.

tools_summary.name: join_curves
tools_summary.description: Join multiple coincident curves into a single polyline if topology allows.

tools_summary.name: list_entities_in_window
tools_summary.description: List handles of all entities whose bounding box intersects the rectangular window.

tools_summary.name: offset_curve
tools_summary.description: Offset a curve by a signed distance, returning the new curve handle.

tools_summary.name: trim_curve
tools_summary.description: Trim a curve at intersections with the boundary list, keeping the side opposite the pick point.
